lines.zh: 我竖着游，背鳍扇得很快。
lines.en: I swim upright, my dorsal fin whirring.
Tail curled around a stalk, I inch forward.

lines.zh: 我飘过去，像一根小树枝。
lines.en: I drift over like a twig.
I copy the color of the coral.
This stretch is slow; do not rush me.
I part the weeds with my snout.

lines.zh: 一阵水流，把我送了一截。
lines.en: A current carries me a short way.

lines.zh: 我贴着一株草，换到下一株。
lines.en: From one stalk to the next I cling.
My fins are tiny; I cannot go fast.

lines.zh: 在礁石之间，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Between the corals I move surely.
One tilt of my body and I turn.
I try not to touch the coral.
Over the grass tips, seeking greener ones.

lines.zh: 这一小段路，我走了很久。
lines.en: This short distance takes me a long while.

lines.zh: 我松开草茎，飘到下一丛。
lines.en: I let go of the stem and drift to the next clump.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子挤过珊瑚的缺口。
lines.en: I turn sideways through a gap in the coral.
Tail curled, I hang from the grass.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和珊瑚一样了。
lines.en: My color now matches the coral.
My fin keeps whirring; it will not stop.

lines.zh: 这里的水很静，正好休息。
lines.en: The water is still here, good for resting.

lines.zh: 我的肚子鼓鼓的，是他的。
lines.en: My pouch is round; the eggs are his.
Bony plates lie under my skin, hard.
I tilt my head at a shrimp.
The stalk bends under my weight.
I barely move, posing as seagrass.
Whirring my small fins tires me.
It is cool in the coral crevice.
I draw water in and out through my gills.
Who stirred the water here?

lines.zh: 我慢慢转个身，继续挂着。
lines.en: I turn slowly and keep hanging.
You are so large; I am so small.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边停下，水都晃了。
lines.en: You stop beside me and the water sways.
Do you see me? I look like weed.
Your eyes are very close to me.
Do not grab me; my bones are brittle.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里，颜色变深了。
lines.en: In your shadow my color darkens.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，珊瑚都挡不住你。
lines.en: You crouch, and the coral cannot hide me.

lines.zh: 我得仰起头，才看得见你。
lines.en: I must crane upward just to see your face.

lines.zh: 你带了桶吗？我不太想进去。
lines.en: Did you bring a bucket? I would rather not.
Your breath bends the seagrass.
A seam has split in my plating.
My curled tail has come undone.
Even a body this small gets struck.
I shrink into the coral crack.
My fin stops for a beat.
Do not squeeze me; I could break.
The blow sent me drifting far.
My snout is scraped.
My colors blur; I cannot hide.
I grip the stalk or be swept away.
Those shrimp are swimming too close.

lines.zh: 你把桶放低，我可以考虑。
lines.en: Lower the bucket; I might consider it.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我要小甲壳。
lines.en: Not bread—I want tiny crustaceans.
There is food in the water you stirred.

lines.zh: 这一株草我不吃，我要虾。
lines.en: I do not eat this stalk; I want shrimp.
The water in the bucket should be cool.
Something is moving in your palm.
I come slowly; keep still.

lines.zh: 太远了，我游不了那么快。
lines.en: Too far; I cannot swim that fast.

lines.zh: 一点点就够了，我嘴很小。
lines.en: A tiny bit is enough; my mouth is small.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了我卷着的尾巴。
lines.en: You knocked my curled tail loose.
The water pushed me against you.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的骨头是硬的。
lines.en: Careful; my bones are stiff plates.
You knocked away the stalk I was holding.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我转了两圈。
lines.en: We bumped and I spun twice.

lines.zh: 你从我头顶游过，水压很大。
lines.en: You swam overhead; the pressure was heavy.
I duck into the coral crack; do not follow.
Your boot nearly came down on me.

lines.zh: 我太小，你根本感觉不到。
lines.en: I am so small you would not feel me.
Move; I need that stalk.
He places the eggs in my pouch.

lines.zh: 我们并排挂着，颜色相同。
lines.en: We hang side by side, the same color.
My belly will swell with them.
We circle a single stalk.
His snout touches mine.
We chose this coral together.

lines.zh: 等小海马出来，我就轻松了。
lines.en: When the fry come out, I will be free.
The current presses us together.
Do not disturb; we are passing eggs.

lines.zh: 我们的颜色，会传给小的。
lines.en: Our colors will pass to the young.
I curl around a broken stalk.
This grain of sand is too heavy; never mind.
I catch a shrimp in my snout.
That scale has a nice color.
I hook it with my tail.
Too small; I cannot hold it.
A bit of broken coral; I put it back.
I pick it up, look, and do not eat.
This stalk is my new home.
Do not take it; that is what I cling to.
That shrimp strayed too far from the weed.

lines.zh: 我看见水里有细小的动静。
lines.en: I see a tiny stirring in the water.
That stalk is just right to hold.
A copepod is swimming there.

lines.zh: 我要那块有阴影的珊瑚。
lines.en: I want that shaded piece of coral.
A fleck falls from the surface.
That little crab is smaller than me.
I fix on a speck of drifting matter.
The water is calmer there; a good spot.
I turn toward it, unhurried.
I lower myself and close in.

lines.zh: 它稍微一动，我立刻悬住。
lines.en: At the slightest movement, I hang still.
I aim my snout at it.
A little closer and I can reach.
It hides behind the weed; I go around.
I judge the direction of the current.
My fin slows its whirring.
It suspects nothing; I hold myself steady.
Just one body-length away.
I do not chase; I wait for it to drift.
I suck it in, quick as that.
My snout is a little tube made for sucking.
One bump and it is stunned.
A light tap, and it flees.
I flick it with my tail.
I bite and hold, small as I am.

lines.zh: 它比我大，我还是顶上去。
lines.en: It is bigger, and I still push.
My plated body does not hurt from bumps.
I knock it off the stalk.
After the strike I curl back into the weed.

lines.zh: 我落在一株草上，轻轻的。
lines.en: I settle on a stalk, very lightly.

lines.zh: 这片珊瑚的颜色，我喜欢。
lines.en: I like the color of this coral.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推上这片浅滩。
lines.en: The tide pushed me onto this shallow bank.
The water is shallow, just as I like.
First I curl around something.
The grass here is taller than elsewhere.
My color has not matched yet.
A new place; I must hide first.
Upright, I survey my surroundings.
One stalk is a whole house.

lines.zh: 水变热了，我的鳍缩起来。
lines.en: The water heats; my fins curl shut.

lines.zh: 我从水里掉出来，摔得很轻。
lines.en: I fall from the water and land softly.
Out of water, my gills stick shut.
The shockwave slams me into coral.
An arrow grazes my back; the stalk snaps.
Light falls on me and I freeze.

lines.zh: 三天没吸到虾，肚子空了。
lines.en: Three days without shrimp; my belly is empty.
Thunder rolls dully through the water.
Below there is no weed and no water.
